subject: Service Disruption — CloudCore Networking
body:
Status: RESOLVED

Incident start: 2027-05-01 22:15 UTC
Incident end: 2027-05-02 06:40 UTC
Duration: 505 minutes
Affected services: CloudCore Networking (us-west-2 region)
Impact: Intermittent packet loss and elevated latency for customers in us-west-2. Approximately 60% of requests failed during peak impact window (00:00–04:00 UTC).
Root cause: Misconfigured BGP routing update during a planned network topology change. The change was classified as operational, not as Scheduled Maintenance.
Resolution: Routing configuration rolled back; traffic rerouted through redundant paths.

Note: This incident was NOT classified as Scheduled Maintenance. No advance notice was provided to customers.

subject: Service Disruption — May 1-2 Incident
body:
Dear Nora,

I'm writing to inform you of a service disruption that affected the Route Optimizer platform from May 1, 2027 at approximately 22:15 UTC to May 2, 2027 at approximately 06:40 UTC (approximately 505 minutes).

The incident was caused by a networking issue at our infrastructure provider. During the peak impact window, approximately 60% of API requests failed. We are treating this as unplanned Downtime for the purposes of our SLA commitments.

A detailed incident report will follow within the timeframe specified in our agreement.

Sincerely,
Raj Subramanian
Head of Customer Success, Quillhub Inc.

body:
